Bill.BriefDescription: Regarding errors in local voters' pamphlets.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to errors in voters' pamphlets; and adding a newsection to chapter 29A.32 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 29A.32 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) When a material error occurs in a local voters' pamphlet, theelection officer shall: (a)(i) Send a notice of correction to a local publication that isestimated to circulate to ninety percent of the active voters affectedby the material error; or (ii) If there are no publications that meet the circulationrequirement, send a letter to the active voters affected by thematerial error stating the correction; and (b) Post a correction of the material error on the electionofficer's web site if one is available. (2) The definitions in this subsection apply throughout thissection unless the context clearly requires otherwise. (a) "Active voter" has the same meaning as in RCW 29A.08.615. p. 1 SB 5508 (b) "Active voters affected by the material error" means activevoters who are qualified to vote on the candidate or issue where thematerial error occurred. (c) "Material error" means anything that pertains to the nature orcharacter of a candidate's identity or anything that wouldsubstantially change the meaning of a proposed measure.
